product_overview: OneWork is a centralized workspace for teams to collaborate across tasks, chat, calls, email, calendar, files, secrets, and notifications. It uses shared authentication and an isolated application schema within the SwiftSoftLabs InsForge environment.
core_goals: Provide a secure, authenticated team workspace under the shared SwiftSoftLabs infrastructure
Support isolated database/schema usage with app-specific role and search path constraints
Enable collaboration through tasks, chat, video calls, email, calendar, files, and notifications
Offer workspace administration through settings, user management, billing, and security controls
Provide utility tools for secrets management, deep links, and integrated external services

features.name: Marketing Homepage
features.description: A public landing page that introduces the OneWork workspace and showcases product capabilities and demos.
user_flows: GET / with no authentication -> Receive 200 HTML page for the public marketing homepage
GET / with invalid or missing session -> Receive public homepage content without requiring auth

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login, signup, email verification, and passkey-based access for users entering the workspace.
user_flows: GET /login -> Receive 200 HTML login page -> Submit valid credentials through login form -> Receive authenticated session and access to protected workspace routes
GET /signup -> Receive 200 HTML signup page -> Submit new user registration with shared auth metadata including app_origin -> Receive account creation flow and proceed to email verification
GET /verify-email -> Receive 200 HTML verification status page -> Confirm verification for pending account -> Receive verified account access eligibility
GET /login -> Receive login page -> Submit invalid credentials or unsupported passkey attempt -> Receive authentication error and remain unauthenticated

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: The authenticated workspace home that provides an overview of activity and navigation to core modules.
user_flows: GET /dashboard with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML dashboard with widgets and sidebar navigation
GET /dashboard without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirected access denial to authentication flow

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Kanban-style project and sprint task boards with task details, subtasks, attachments, and deep-linkable task modals.
user_flows: GET /tasks with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML task board with project selector and task cards -> Open deep-linked /tasks?projectId={uuid}&open={taskUuid} -> Receive 200 HTML page with task detail modal
GET /tasks?projectId={uuid}&open={taskUuid} with valid session and seeded task data -> Receive 200 HTML page with task modal opened for the matching task
GET /tasks with missing or invalid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login
GET /tasks?projectId=invalid&open=invalid with valid session -> Receive page without task modal or an error state indicating invalid deep link parameters

features.name: Team Chat
features.description: Real-time team messaging with conversations, threads, reactions, attachments, and presence indicators.
user_flows: GET /chat with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML chat interface with conversations and message threads
GET /chat without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login

features.name: Video Calls
features.description: LiveKit-powered audio and video calls with call rooms, recording, transcription, and AI meeting notes.
user_flows: GET /calls with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML calls list and scheduling interface -> Select a call and open /calls/{id}/room -> Receive 200 HTML LiveKit call room with media controls
GET /calls/{id}/room with valid session and LiveKit/media permissions -> Join active call room successfully and access audio/video controls
GET /calls/{id}/room with missing permissions or unavailable LiveKit server -> Receive call room error state indicating media or connection failure
GET /calls without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login

features.name: Calendar
features.description: A calendar and events view that surfaces synced events from connected integrations.
user_flows: GET /calendar with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML calendar view with events
GET /calendar without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login
GET /calendar with connected integrations unavailable -> Receive calendar page with empty, partial, or sync error state

features.name: Email
features.description: An integrated email inbox with compose, account linking, and AI-assisted email workflows.
user_flows: GET /email with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML inbox listing
GET /email/compose with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML compose email page
GET /email/accounts/connect with OAuth provider configured -> Initiate account linking and complete email integration setup
GET /email without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login
GET /email/accounts/connect without OAuth provider configuration -> Receive integration setup error due to missing provider credentials

features.name: Files
features.description: A file browser for organizing folders, uploading documents, and downloading stored assets.
user_flows: GET /files with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML file browser and upload interface -> Upload a file through the files API -> Receive confirmation and updated file listing
GET /files without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login
POST /api/files/upload with unsupported file type or oversized payload -> Receive validation error and file not stored

features.name: Secrets Vault
features.description: An environment-scoped vault for managing secret variables, auditing access, and syncing with CLI workflows.
user_flows: GET /vault with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML vault management UI -> View variables and summary data from vault APIs
GET /vault without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login
GET /vault with invalid variable scope or missing permissions -> Receive vault access error or empty restricted view

features.name: Settings
features.description: Workspace settings for profile management, user administration, billing, and security options such as 2FA and passkeys.
user_flows: GET /settings with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML workspace settings page
GET /settings/[slug] with a valid settings section slug -> Receive section-specific settings page for profile, users, billing, or security
GET /settings without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login
GET /settings/[slug] with unknown slug -> Receive settings navigation error or not-found response

features.name: Notifications
features.description: An in-app notification center with preferences, activity inbox, and deep links into tasks and calls.
user_flows: GET /notifications with valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML notification inbox
GET /notifications without valid session -> Receive 401 or redirect to login
GET /api/notifications/preferences with updated preference payload -> Receive saved notification preferences
GET /api/notifications/preferences with invalid payload -> Receive validation error and preferences remain unchanged

known_limitations.impact: Call room tests may fail without media device access
